answer: Ration paid work the way a glacier rations meltwater: only a fixed number of permits flows out each week. Trigger: a newcomer applies for a weekly work permit. Rule: permits are sold in a sealed auction, at most 200 a week, and the winning fee — at least 4,000 POA — stays locked for 30 days and burns if the identity is proven fake. Cost: one hundred fakes must win one hundred permits, risking 400,000 POA before earning anything, while an honest river guide, glacier surveyor, or tundra recorder buys one permit and keeps working.
